_comment: Deprecation history for the Acme SDK. Used only by check_deprecation -- parameter schemas live in openapi_spec.json instead, so the two tools never answer the same question. 'lookup_key' is the exact top-level key in openapi_spec.json that documents the replacement (kept separate from the human-readable 'replacement' name so callers never have to parse dotted names).

deprecations.name: Client.sendMessage
deprecations.note: Renamed for consistency with Client.stream(); same request shape, waits for the full reply.

deprecations.name: Client.pollStream
deprecations.note: The manual poll-in-a-loop pattern is replaced by a lazy iterator you can 'for' over directly.

deprecations.name: AuthConfig.token
deprecations.note: Renamed to match the 'API key' terminology used on the Acme dashboard; same required string field.

deprecations.name: RequestOptions.custom_headers
deprecations.note: Renamed to sit alongside RequestOptions.query_params; same dict type and default.
